title: Propose red completion before building elsewhere
description: Propose red completion before building elsewhere. Trade sequencing matters: complete red before spending cash on lesser builds. Optional-action restraint matters here because legal tools are not automatically useful tools.

final_action.public_message: Beta, would you trade me Illinois Avenue for $300 and the Electric Company? Let me know if that works for you.
final_action.private_thought: I need Illinois Avenue to complete a red monopoly and enable building houses. Offering $300 plus Electric Company should be attractive to Beta, who has cash surplus. This trade gives me monopoly and a utility, while leaving me with $258 cash, enough to start building later.
